set.body: Implement ordered native playback concatenation as a separate checked sidecar, preserving physical sources and occurrence identity, exact rational target clock, forward/inverse support and shared measurement. Connect actual Sherlock rows/scenes and installed CLI with independent boundary/gap/point oracles. No fabricated media SHA, participant data, or provider calls; remaining arbitrary mappings and recall-clock links stay owed.
set.title: Compose native source playback with exact occurrence-preserving readouts
